title: Nammai Kaakkum 48 – Innuyir Kappom Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Nammai Kaakkum 48 – Innuyir Kappom
Jurisdiction: Tamil Nadu, India
Category: Emergency road-accident treatment
Type: Emergency Healthcare Assistance
Details: Tamil Nadu initiative supporting emergency treatment for eligible road-accident victims at designated hospitals, subject to current rules.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Road-accident victims meeting current Tamil Nadu programme conditions and receiving care at designated hospitals; verify current limits.
Individual Enrolment Required: False

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Emergency/accident and hospital records; identity details if available. Do not delay emergency stabilization to obtain documents.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Seek immediate care at a designated participating hospital and ask the scheme desk to confirm eligibility and formalities.
Official Portal: https://www.cmchistn.com/
